title: Green object over Savannah River Site engineers

tellings.quote: Anderson and his colleagues were quickly overtaken by a green glowing object angular and size darting back and forth erratically at high speeds and altitudes with phenomenal maneuverability

plain: In 1952, at the Savannah River Site, a nuclear facility in South Carolina, an engineer named John Anderson and his colleagues were "quickly overtaken by a green glowing object," angular in shape, that darted back and forth erratically at high speeds and altitudes "with phenomenal maneuverability." Michels recounts it himself, without naming a source, in an episode with the researcher Robert Hastings about UFOs watching nuclear sites, and it would suggest an early interest by such objects in America's nuclear work.
